_comment:
Arms in the air, without any arms. There is no guaranteed arm part on a rig, so the arms-up read is faked the way limited animation has always faked it: a hard vertical STRETCH of the body (scaleY up, scaleX in) snapping out of a crouch, a whole-actor scaleBy pop with a bit of lift, sparkle over the head and a triumph sting. The audience supplies the arms.

The comedy is entirely in the 0.30s crouch before it - the wind-up is longer than the whoop. Face goes happy -> surprised (the open-mouth shout) -> happy, which is the closest the six faces get to a cheer.

Deliberately NOT animated: arms, hat-throwing, any clip. Everything here works on the day a rig is generated, with no declarations.
triggers: throws his arms in the air
throws her arms in the air
threw his arms in the air

beats._comment: the crouch, held 0.30s. Longer than the cheer it launches - that asymmetry is the gag.
the arms-up read: a hard stretch snapping out of the crouch on one frame. Parts do not tween, which is exactly what is wanted here.
the pop, RELATIVE - scaleBy on the mark, never `scale`.
open mouth = the shout. 0.18s after the stretch so it is not eaten by the same frame at 12fps.
eased back down onto the mark - and this is also the restore, so nothing carries into the rest of the scene.
small landing squash, arriving after the eased descent
back to the rig's rest pose
